contentBlocks.value:
Let's Do It! Vietnam is a member of the Let's Do It! World network of organizations. Through our core activities of cleanups and waste-issue training, we aim to raise public awareness and improve the current environmental situation.

To prepare for our upcoming activities, Let's Do It! Vietnam is looking for more Local Coordinators in provinces and cities nationwide:

GENERAL REQUIREMENTS FOR CANDIDATES:

A citizen living and working in Vietnam, aged 15 or older.
Interested in environmental issues and community-oriented activities.
Ability to mobilize local resources directly (people, funding, equipment) to carry out activities is a plus.
Priority given to those with experience managing and executing projects.
GENERAL BENEFITS OF PARTICIPATING:
Training to improve leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
Provided with the professional skills and knowledge needed.
Expand your network with other Coordinators and dynamic young people who share the same passion.
Receive a certificate and letter of recommendation from Let's Do It! Vietnam upon completing your duties.
Help spread the message of environmental protection, contributing to a greener, more beautiful Vietnam.

Don't miss this exciting opportunity to join the Let's Do It! Vietnam team!
Application period: from July 13, 2025 to August 3, 2025.
Interview format and timing: Online interviews from August 1–10, 2025 (tentative).

Website: https://www.worldcleanupday.org/country/vietnam/ – https://letsdoitvietnam.org/
Email: letsdoitvietnam@gmail.com
Tel: 035.872.6755 (Mr. Son) or 0968.514.882 (Ms. Tu)
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/LetsDoItVietNam
